## Rule

Input (2..3)x(2..3) is placed at the center of an (H+2)x(W+2) output; edge rows/cols smear one cell outward; corners bg-0; canvas cells beyond the output region stay empty. LIVE implements via a size-keyed [4,25] scatter LUT.
